subject: TriadBank MAP: onboarding runway, SIG wrap-up, DPA redline and data lifecycle plan
messages:
From: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@triadbank.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@triadbank.com>, security.ops@triadbank.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP request & baseline timeline for SOC 2 / SIG / DPA

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Legal and Security want to align the mutual action plan (MAP) around the security gates so we can track acceptance milestones. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm which SOC 2 artifacts you can provide (SOC 2 Type II report, bridging letters, or confirmation of upcoming audit).
- SIG/CAIQ questionnaire cadence — will you deliver the annotated CAIQ or complete the SIG portal?
- DPA redline window and a target for signed DPA (we need final before any production data).
- Data retention options (we need retention at ingestion + ability to purge on demand; preferred windows: 30/90/365).

Can you put together a short MAP with ownership and dates? Our ideal is to have DPA signed and SIG questions closed within three weeks so our compliance committee can greenlight the pilot.

Appreciate it — I can loop in procurement when we have the DPA timeline.

-- Alex
Senior PM, TriadBank

Attachments: none
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Subject: Re: TriadBank MAP: onboarding runway, SIG wrap-up, DPA redline and data lifecycle plan

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. I've sketched a MAP below that maps security/compliance gates to owners and proposed dates. This is a starting point; happy to tighten after your feedback.

MAP (proposed) — milestone / owner / target date
- 1) SIG/CAIQ annotated draft delivered — Redwood (Priyom) — 2026-09-24
- 2) SOC 2 artifacts (latest Type II report + control matrix) — Redwood (Stephanie) — 2026-09-25
- 3) DPA redline received from Triad — Triad Legal — 2026-09-23
- 4) Redwood internal review + reply to DPA redline — Redwood Legal (Stephanie) — 2026-09-26
- 5) Evidence handoff (S3 share + index spreadsheet) — Redwood (Neha) — 2026-09-28
- 6) Final sign & DocuSign (DPA) — mutual — 2026-10-01
- 7) Acceptance window / pilot kickoff (no production PII until sign) — mutual — 2026-10-04

Notes / clarifications:
- SOC 2: we can provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a control mapping spreadsheet. If you require an additional bridging letter, we can add that but it typically adds 1 week.
- SIG/CAIQ: Priyom will attach an annotated CAIQ and mark out items requiring professional services or design changes.
- Data retention: Neha outlines options below. Immediate purge APIs exist for test data; production purge will be scoped in the DPA.

I attached a security evidence index (redwood-security-evidence-inventory.xlsx) with the first-pass list of artifacts and owners.

Next steps: if Triad legal can send DPA redlines by EOD 9/23, we’ll aim for a response on 9/26 and a DocuSign push the following week.

Best —
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Solutions Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-security-evidence-inventory.xlsx
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Date: 2026-09-23T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriadBank MAP: onboarding runway, SIG wrap-up, DPA redline and data lifecycle plan

Alex / team — a few technical clarifications on data lifecycle and retention that matter for the DPA and acceptance criteria: 

1) Retention windows we support (configurable per-tenant):
   - 30 days (default for short-term test workloads)
   - 90 days (recommended for pilot analytics)
   - 365 days (enterprise archival)

2) Purge semantics:
   - Immediate logical deletion API (returns 202; we then scrub KV cache and mark tokens for deletion within 24 hours).
   - Full physical purge from object storage and backups is scheduled (up to 30 days depending on backup window) unless you opt into accelerated purge (adds coordination fee).

3) Residency & encryption:
   - We can host inference in US-east or US-west regions for Triad. Key management: customer-managed keys (KMS) supported via AWS KMS; HSM/Bring-your-own-key discussion possible in private deployments.

4) Evidence handoff format:
   - We will provide a zipped evidence bundle (pdfs + control matrix) and a canonical index spreadsheet. Sensitive artifacts (keys, mTLS certs) will be transferred via an approved SFTP / vault entry.

If the DPA needs an explicit retention SLA for backups and escrow, include that clause in redline and we’ll propose precise language.

— Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moretti <alex.moretti@triadbank.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Tara Singh <tara.singh@triadbank.com>, security.ops@triadbank.com
Date: 2026-09-25T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TriadBank MAP: onboarding runway, SIG wrap-up, DPA redline and data lifecycle plan

Thanks Stephanie / Neha — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from Legal & Security review: 

- Triad Legal will send DPA redlines by 9/23 end-of-day (we missed that target — updated ETA 9/26). Will that push your review window?
- For retention: our compliance team requires a max 90-day default for any production account unless we sign an explicit archival annex. Can you confirm 90-day default setting and that accelerated purge fees would be written into the DPA?
- SOC 2: can you confirm the SOC 2 Type II report covers the hosted API surface (text generation + embeddings) and the most recent audit period? If not, what controls differ?

We’ll upload the DPA redline to the Drive link you shared. Also please add a HubSpot task assigned to Stephanie for final sign follow-up.

On timing: if Redwood can respond to redlines by 9/29 we can keep the sign target ~10/04. Is that workable?

— Alex

Alex — thanks for the update and the revised ETA. We can accommodate a DPA redline on 9/26 with a response by 9/29; slipping sign to 10/04 is fine. Finalized commitments below to lock into the MAP: 

Agreed timeline (final):
- 2026-09-26: Triad submits DPA redline (Triad Legal) — ACTION: Alex / Tara
- 2026-09-29: Redwood counter-redline and annotated response (Stephanie / Redwood Legal) — deliverable: triad-dpa-redlines.docx
- 2026-09-30: Redwood delivers SIG annotated CAIQ and evidence index (Priyom / Neha) — deliverable: sig-caiq-answers-annotated.pdf + evidence bundle link
- 2026-10-01: Target DocuSign push for DPA (mutual) — ACTION: Procurement teams
- 2026-10-04: Pilot acceptance window begins (non-production can begin earlier with NDAs) — ACTION: Mutual

Specifics to include in the DPA (we will mirror in our counter):
- Default retention: 90 days for production data unless Triad signs archival annex for 365d.
- Purge semantics: logical purge immediate; physical purge up to 30 days (accelerated purge available as optional clause).
- KMS: support for customer-managed keys via AWS KMS; private deployment options require a separate SOW.
- Evidence transfer: secure drive link + index spreadsheet; sensitive artifacts via SFTP / vault with access logs.

Next steps (immediate):
- Alex / Tara: upload DPA redline to Drive by 9/26 and create HubSpot deal note (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3482).
- Priyom: final annotated CAIQ will be uploaded to Drive by 9/30.
- Neha: prepare evidence bundle and mark items that require engineering changes (if any).

If Triad wants a short 30-minute sync on 9/27 to walk through the DPA hotspots before redline submission, I’m available 9:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

— Stephanie
Head of Solutions Security, Redwood Inference
